exposure: duration of second stage of labor
cohort: The study included primiparous women with singleton pregnancies of at least 36+6 weeks gestation.
finding: Perineal body length less than 2.5 cm significantly predisposed to spontaneous perineal lacerations.
mod_finding: Duration of second stage of labor longer than 60 minutes and occiput posterior presentation were associated with an increased risk of episiotomy.
